OR-E3.Description:
Deliver the public product discovery experience: paginated catalogue APIs and the homepage, listing, category, product detail, and search pages, plus a local shopping list.

SCOPE:
- Public read APIs: products (filter/sort/paginate), product detail, categories, search
- Availability service producing honest labels
- Frontend Zod schemas and reusable product components
- Homepage, product listing, category, product detail, and search results pages
- Local shopping list/cart stored in the browser only

OUT OF SCOPE:
- Referral handoff behaviour (placeholder slot only; implemented in OR-E4)
- Full SEO metadata/JSON-LD (OR-E5)
- Payment, delivery address, or account features — never in scope

REFERENCE DOCS:
- frontend/AGENT.md (Page Specifications, Data Fetching, Accessibility)
- backend/AGENT.md (API Endpoint Pattern)
- docs/CATALOGUE-DATA.md (Availability Rules)

SUCCESS CRITERIA:
- Search, category browsing, and product details work against fixtures or authorised data
- All list endpoints are paginated with bounded page sizes
- Availability is shown only when verified; otherwise 'Check availability at Oriflame' or 'Availability not confirmed'
- Development fixture data is visibly labelled as such
- Shopping list works without accounts and collects no payment or address data
- Backend and frontend gates pass

OR-E3.Summary: Products API: listing with filter/sort/pagination and product detail
OR-E3.Description:
Expose visible products through typed, paginated endpoints.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- GET /api/v1/products: query model (category slug, min/max price, sort in name_asc/name_desc/price_asc/price_desc/newest, page >= 1, page_size 1–100 default 24); response {items, total, page, page_size}
- GET /api/v1/products/{slug}: detail with images, categories, price_pkr, availability label, source_url, last_synced_at, related products (same category, limit 4)
- ProductService in services/products.py; repository query functions; routers hold no logic
- Only is_visible products returned; data_source field included so the UI can flag development fixtures

EFFORT: M (6 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-E2

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Pagination totals correct; page_size > 100 rejected (422)
- Each sort order verified; invalid sort rejected
- Hidden products return 404 on detail and are excluded from lists
- Unknown slug returns 404 with safe message

EDGE CASES:
- Products with NULL price: excluded from price filters, sorted last for price sorts, shown as 'Price not available'
- Page beyond last page: empty items with correct total, not an error
- Slug with invalid characters: 422, never reaches the database

Expose the category tree and category detail for navigation and category pages.

DEPENDENCIES: OR-018

OR-E3.Summary: Search API with PostgreSQL full-text search
OR-E3.Description:
Provide relevant, safe product search.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Migration adding a generated tsvector column (name weighted A, description B) with GIN index, plus pg_trgm index on name (CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm WITH SCHEMA extensions — Supabase convention) for fuzzy fallback
- GET /api/v1/search?q=&page=&page_size=: websearch_to_tsquery ranking; trigram similarity fallback when no full-text hits
- Same response shape and pagination as products listing
- Rate limit applied (shared limiter introduced here or in OR-E6; document which)

EFFORT: M (5 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend / Database
DEPENDENCIES: OR-018

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Exact name match ranks first; partial and misspelled queries return sensible results
- q length bounded (1–100); empty q returns 422
- Migration reversible; no drift

EDGE CASES:
- Query with SQL/tsquery special characters: handled safely by websearch_to_tsquery and parameters
- Non-Latin input (Urdu): no error; returns results if present, otherwise empty
- Hidden products never appear in results

Centralise how availability is described so no page can overstate it.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- services/availability.py: availability_for(product) returning a typed status: verified_in_stock / verified_out_of_stock / not_confirmed, plus label text and checked_at
- verified_* only when ProductAvailability data exists from the source and is within a freshness window (configurable, documented); otherwise not_confirmed with label 'Availability not confirmed' (list) / 'Check availability at Oriflame' (detail CTA context)
- GET /api/v1/availability/{slug} if the detail payload alone is insufficient
- Never expose stock quantities

EFFORT: S (3 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-018

TESTING CRITERIA:
- No availability data: not_confirmed
- Stale data beyond window: not_confirmed (not 'in stock')
- Fresh verified data: verified status with checked_at

EDGE CASES:
- Source provides quantities: stored if useful but never returned or displayed
- Labels never use wording implying real-time stock unless the source is genuinely real-time and ADR-001 says so

OR-E3.Summary: Frontend catalogue schemas and product components
OR-E3.Description:
Build the typed data layer and reusable UI pieces for catalogue pages.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- frontend/lib/api/schemas/: product, productPage, category, searchResult Zod schemas; api functions getProducts, getProduct, getCategories, getCategory, searchProducts
- components/product/: ProductCard, ProductGrid, Price (formats PKR with Intl.NumberFormat('en-PK'), 'Price not available' for null), AvailabilityBadge, ProductImage (next/image, factual alt text, placeholder when no authorised image)
- components/layout/: Header with category navigation and search box, Footer with independence disclaimer, DevDataBanner shown when any rendered item has data_source dev_fixture
- next.config images.remotePatterns set only to authorised hosts from ADR-001

EFFORT: M (6 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Frontend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-018, OR-019, OR-021

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Vitest: Price formatting and null case; AvailabilityBadge labels per status; ProductCard accessible name and link
- DevDataBanner renders for fixture items only
- Zod rejects malformed API payloads

EDGE CASES:
- Image URL from unauthorised host: not rendered; placeholder used
- Very long product names: truncated visually with full name accessible
- Components remain Server Components unless interactive

- AddToListButton on cards and PDP; header indicator with item count
- /list page (or drawer) showing items, quantities, indicative total in PKR labelled 'Indicative — final price on Oriflame'
- Handoff button slot for OR-E4

EFFORT: M (5 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Frontend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-025

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Add, update quantity, remove, persist across reloads
- Keyboard and screen-reader operable; count changes announced
- No network request sends list contents; no address/payment fields exist

- Corrupted or old-version stored data: discarded safely
